orgId.title: Organisation ID
orgId.description: Tenant identifier issued by BlueBot. The extension stays INACTIVE until this is set by managed policy, so a user who installs it manually collects nothing.

userId.title: User identifier
userId.description: Opaque per-employee id (e.g. a hash of the work email). Never send the raw email.

serverUrl.title: Ingest URL
serverUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives security events, e.g. https://shield.bayesiancybersecurity.com/collect

allowlistOrigins.title: Known third-party origins
allowlistOrigins.description: Origins the org treats as normal (CDNs, SSO, analytics). Everything else is 'novel'.

personalDomains.title: Excluded personal domains
personalDomains.description: Domains never monitored at all (banking, health, personal mail). Matched on the registrable domain.

collectFullUrl.title: Collect full URLs
collectFullUrl.description: Default false. When false only the origin (scheme+host) is sent, never the path or query. Leave false unless legal has approved full-URL capture.

monitorIncognito.title: Monitor incognito windows
monitorIncognito.description: Default false. Keep false; incognito is for personal use.
